posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
For a start, you can port the MV horns (since you own it) to MZ, it is really doable for them (maybe a little annoying, but really just careful cut and paste.
Can we Use MV Generator Parts in MZ? | The Official RPG Maker Blog
With the newest iteration of RPG Maker we got a reworked graphic style which sadly blocks us from using MV generator parts in MZ. Or… Does it? A lot of people on our forums consider this “not doable”, but let's see if that is really true today.
www.rpgmakerweb.com

posts.author: NikaraWorld
posts.body: More then a little annoying but with the latest extended generator release it is doable, that just leave the singular horn in the middle of the forehead. I don't see a horn like that in the MV generator parts.
